questions.question: After giving his own gold and silver for the temple, what question did King David ask the people of Israel?

answers.text: Who is willing to consecrate himself to the LORD today
Who will march out against the Philistines with me
Who will go up to Lebanon to cut cedar

questions.question: In his prayer, King David asked God how his people could give so generously for the temple. What answer did he give?

answers.text: Everything comes from God's own hand
The people worked extra hard all year
The king of Tyre sent them help

questions.question: When Solomon took the throne in place of his father King David, how did his reign begin?

answers.text: He prospered and all Israel obeyed him
The tribes rose up against him

questions.question: After forty years as king of Israel, how did David's life end?

answers.text: He died at a ripe old age full of honor
He fell in battle against the Philistines
He died alone and forgotten in the palace
